title: High-degree noise norm bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $f$ a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$, with variance at most $1$. Let $0\le\delta\le1$ and $k\ge0$ be real numbers. The $L^2$ norm of the part of the noise operator applied to $f$ with Fourier degrees strictly greater than $\lfloor k\rfloor$ is at most $\exp(-\delta k)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$
